question: how is our school performing overall
sql: SELECT 'Active students' AS metric, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE is_active = 'yes') AS CHAR) AS value UNION ALL SELECT 'Active staff', CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE is_active = 1) AS CHAR) UNION ALL SELECT 'Student attendance % this month', CAST(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('p','present') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS CHAR) FROM student_attendences sa LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Fee collected this month', CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date')) AS jt WHERE MONTH(jt.payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(jt.payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) AS CHAR) UNION ALL SELECT 'Outstanding fee balance', CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sfm.amount) FROM student_fees_master sfm), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt), 0) AS CHAR) UNION ALL SELECT 'New admissions this month', CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE MONTH(admission_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(admission_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS CHAR) UNION ALL SELECT 'Admission enquiries this month', CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enquiry WHERE MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS CHAR)

question: give me risk analysis of the school
sql: SELECT 'Students with attendance below 75%' AS risk_indicator, CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS count FROM (SELECT s.id, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('p','present') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY s.id HAVING pct < 75) t UNION ALL SELECT 'Students with outstanding fees', CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) FROM (SELECT s.id, COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) AS balance FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.student_session_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sfd.student_fees_master_id, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS paid FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt GROUP BY sfd.student_fees_master_id) p ON p.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id GROUP BY s.id HAVING balance > 0) t2 UNION ALL SELECT 'Students with negative behaviour points', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT si.student_id) AS CHAR) FROM student_incidents si JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id WHERE sb.point < 0 AND MONTH(si.created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(si.created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Open complaints', CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) FROM complaint WHERE action_taken IS NULL OR TRIM(action_taken) = '' UNION ALL SELECT 'Pending admission enquiries', CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) FROM enquiry WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('active', 'pending', 'open') UNION ALL SELECT 'Staff leave pending approval', CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) FROM staff_leave_request WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('pending', 'in progress')

question: where is our school lacking
sql: SELECT area AS concern_area, issue_count FROM (SELECT 'Low student attendance (<75%)' AS area, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM (SELECT s.id, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('p','present') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY s.id HAVING pct < 75) x UNION ALL SELECT 'Fee collection gap (outstanding > 0)', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT s.id FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.student_session_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sfd.student_fees_master_id, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS paid FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt GROUP BY sfd.student_fees_master_id) p ON p.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id GROUP BY s.id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) > 0) y UNION ALL SELECT 'Behaviour incidents (negative points)', COUNT(DISTINCT si.student_id) FROM student_incidents si JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id WHERE sb.point < 0 AND MONTH(si.created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(si.created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Homework not submitted', COUNT(*) FROM homework WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('', '0', 'pending', 'not submitted') UNION ALL SELECT 'Open complaints', COUNT(*) FROM complaint WHERE action_taken IS NULL OR TRIM(action_taken) = '') z ORDER BY issue_count DESC LIMIT 20

question: what is our profit this month
sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) AS total_income, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM expenses WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) AS total_expense, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(net_salary) FROM staff_payroll WHERE MONTH(payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) AS payroll_cost, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM expenses WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(net_salary) FROM staff_payroll WHERE MONTH(payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) AS estimated_net_surplus

question: show income expense and payroll summary this month
sql: SELECT 'Income' AS category, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total FROM income WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Expenses', COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM expenses WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Payroll', COALESCE(SUM(net_salary), 0) FROM staff_payroll WHERE MONTH(payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Fee collections', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date')) AS jt WHERE MONTH(jt.payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(jt.payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0)

question: show top 10 expense entries this month
sql: SELECT e.name AS expense_head, e.invoice_no, e.amount, e.description, e.date FROM expenses e WHERE MONTH(e.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(e.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY e.amount DESC LIMIT 10

question: break down expenses by category this month
sql: SELECT e.name AS expense_head, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount FROM expenses e WHERE MONTH(e.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(e.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 50

question: break down income by head this month
sql: SELECT i.name AS income_head, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, SUM(i.amount) AS total_amount FROM income i WHERE MONTH(i.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(i.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY i.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 50

question: what is our student enrollment growth rate
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(admission_date, '%Y-%m') AS month_label, COUNT(*) AS new_admissions FROM students WHERE admission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(admission_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month_label DESC LIMIT 12

question: compare new student admissions this month vs last month
sql: SELECT 'This month' AS period, COUNT(*) AS new_students FROM students WHERE MONTH(admission_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(admission_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Last month', COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE admission_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND admission_date < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')

question: how many new staff joined this month
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_staff_this_month FROM staff WHERE MONTH(joining_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(joining_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())

question: what is our staff to student ratio
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE is_active = 'yes') AS active_students, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE is_active = 1) AS active_staff, ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE is_active = 'yes') / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE is_active = 1), 0), 2) AS students_per_staff

question: admission enquiry conversion rate this year
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_enquiries, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_enquiries, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS conversion_percent FROM enquiry WHERE YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE())

question: show fee collection trend by month
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(jt.payment_date, '%Y-%m') AS month_label, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS total_collected FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date')) AS jt WHERE jt.payment_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(jt.payment_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month_label DESC LIMIT 12

question: which classes have the lowest attendance this month
sql: SELECT c.class AS class_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('p','present') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS attendance_percent FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY c.class ORDER BY attendance_percent ASC LIMIT 20

question: average exam marks by class
sql: SELECT c.class AS class_name, ROUND(AVG(ms.exam_marks), 2) AS avg_marks, ROUND(AVG(ms.exam_marks / NULLIF(ms.exam_total, 0) * 100), 2) AS avg_percent FROM mark_sheet ms JOIN exam_schedule es ON es.id = ms.exam_schedule_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = ms.student_session_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id WHERE ms.exam_total > 0 GROUP BY c.class ORDER BY avg_percent ASC LIMIT 50

question: list students at risk academically or financially
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, c.class AS class_name, ROUND(att.pct, 1) AS attendance_percent, COALESCE(fee.balance, 0) AS fee_balance, COALESCE(beh.total_points, 0) AS behaviour_points FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss2.student_id, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('p','present') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss2 ON ss2.id = sa.student_session_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY ss2.student_id) att ON att.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.id AS student_id, COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) AS balance FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.student_session_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sfd.student_fees_master_id, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS paid FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt GROUP BY sfd.student_fees_master_id) p ON p.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id GROUP BY s.id) fee ON fee.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT si.student_id, SUM(sb.point) AS total_points FROM student_incidents si JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id GROUP BY si.student_id) beh ON beh.student_id = s.id WHERE (att.pct < 75 OR fee.balance > 0 OR beh.total_points < -5) ORDER BY fee.balance DESC, att.pct ASC LIMIT 50

question: show negative behaviour incidents this month
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sb.title, sb.point, si.created_at FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id WHERE sb.point < 0 AND MONTH(si.created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(si.created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY sb.point ASC LIMIT 50

question: online admission applications pipeline status
sql: SELECT form_status, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM online_admissions WHERE MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY form_status ORDER BY application_count DESC LIMIT 50

question: what percent of income goes to payroll
sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) AS income_month, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(net_salary) FROM staff_payroll WHERE MONTH(payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) AS payroll_month, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE((SELECT SUM(net_salary) FROM staff_payroll WHERE MONTH(payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0), 2) AS payroll_percent_of_income

question: give me school performance report
